description: This file implements an 'alias' plugin for the lighttpd web server, enabling URL path aliasing and redirection. It contains functions for initializing, merging configuration, checking order, and remapping URLs based on configured alias rules.

methods.name: mod_alias_init
methods.description: Initializes plugin data structure for alias configuration.

methods.description: Applies the plugin configuration to the current request context.

methods.name: int mod_alias_check_order(server * const srv,const array * const a)
methods.description: Validates the order of alias URL prefixes, ensuring no prefix is shadowed by a longer prefix.

methods.name: mod_alias_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration options for the alias plugin based on global settings.

methods.name: handler_t mod_alias_remap(request_st * const r,const array * const aliases)
methods.description: Performs the URL path alias remapping based on configured alias rules.

methods.name: mod_alias_physical_handler
methods.description: Handles physical requests by applying URL aliasing logic.

methods.name: int mod_alias_plugin_init(plugin * p)
methods.description: Registers the plugin's initialization and handler functions with the server.
